blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Armed with their experience from Alas Pilipinas, Capital1’s newest duo, Vanie Gandler and Erika Santos, are eager to make an immediate impact in the three-series PVL All-Filipino Conference. After missing the Asian Games’ final line-up, Gandler and Santos shift their focus to their new chapter with the Solar Spikers with the Siklab series starting on October 10 at SM Seaside Cebu Arena. “Of course, we’re thankful for the international experience. It wasn’t easy, but it was also good that we got to experience it because now we can share with our team whatever we learned and whatever we […]...
